D2SA & -379.9 & -25.23000 & 30.09696 & 1860.0 & Cz & Common Main Zone Coarse Grained Gabbronorite (Office interp: Leucogabbronorite; porphyritic gabbronorite); On Dirt road to Klipriver Farms, Boulder piles outcropping of main zone. These rocks are the building materials for much of the structures in the area. Weathering is quite distinct from Marginal zone. Both have exfoliation/onion skin weathering. Main Zone is prouder, forming impressive rounded boulders like a granite. Weathered faces have distinct dalmatian pattern. A large boulder (float) at this outcrop contains a characteristic pyroxene “tennisball”, a well-known marker at the base of the Main Zone.  \\
